name: Kuttysuchus
isnote: English Wikipedia calls it a typothoracine, probably a basal paratypothoracin; the atlas parent is Typothoracinae.
sum: Kuttysuchus is a small armoured aetosaur known only from isolated osteoderms from the Late Triassic Dharmaram Formation of India.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given; the species name refers to the small size of the osteoderms.
holotype: One almost complete paramedian osteoderm; catalogue number not given on the page.
material: Isolated osteoderms, likely from the anterior or middle tail armour.
biology: The sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Haldar et al. 2024

sources.text: Haldar, A., Ray, S. and Bandyopadhyay, S. 2024. A new paratypothoracin aetosaur (Archosauria: Pseudosuchia) from the Upper Triassic Dharmaram Formation of India and its biostratigraphic implications. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 44(3): e2439533.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Mid or late Norian to Rhaetian (English Wikipedia).
